item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 23/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, it will be generally fine and persistently very hot over the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Doksuri will move across the seas east of Luzon and intensify gradually. Its outer subsiding air will continue to bring very hot weather to southern China midweek this week. Showers and squally thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Doksuri is expected to gradually edge closer to the vicinity of Taiwan this week. However, the chance of Doksuri moving towards the coast of eastern Guangdong still cannot be ruled out.
